xpath.div:
⚠️ Void Record Not Yet Validated
This transfer has been voided, but the corresponding void record has not yet been validated.
Please navigate to the Void Equivalent Record (via the smart button) and validate it to complete the void process.
Note: If the move lines were accidentally deleted, you can unvoid this transfer and re-void it. The system will reuse the existing void record and re-populate the stock moves.

div.invisible: not is_void_return and not is_void_wr or state == 'done'

xpath.div:
ℹ️ Void Record - Simplified Process
This is a void record. Complete the following steps:
1. Review and complete any stock move details if needed.
2. Click Validate button to finalize the void process.
That's all! No other actions are required for void records.
After validation is complete, go back to the void parent equivalent record — that will be your next step.

div.invisible: not show_return_alert or state not in ['done']

xpath.div:
⚠️ Draft Return Transaction Pending
Steps to Process:
1. Click Return Pallets
2. Select the Pallet you wish to return
3. Click Process Return

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'Generate Pallet Lines' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
⚠️ Action Required: Generate Pallet Lines
Click the "Generate Pallet Lines" button to create pallet line entries based on your product estimates.
Tip: If the Tally Sheet appears empty, you likely skipped this step.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'Estimate Pallet Lines' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Steps to Complete:
1. Add products in the Operations → Product column
2. Complete the Documented Quantity, Packs and Weight (KG) based on the Client's DR/Client Reference
3. Fill in the No. of Pallet Lines for each product
Best Practice: Always OVERESTIMATE the number of pallets per Product SKU.
Note: This step can be skipped for unpredictable Product SKUs (e.g., FCA Assorted).

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'BF Complete Pallet Details' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Next Steps:
1. Generate the Tally Sheet and provide it to the Checker.
2. Once returned, encode the data under Pallet Breakdown (located at top-center of screen).
3. Ensure all required columns are properly completed.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'RR Complete Pallet Details' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Steps to Complete:
1. Assign Pallet Series and set all Location to an Aisle (Temporary) inside Pallet Breakdown (top-center of screen).
2. Generate the Tally Sheet and Pallet Tag Form.
3. Provide both documents to the Checker.
4. Once returned, encode the data again under Pallet Breakdown using the Magic Wizard inside (top-center of screen).
5. Ensure all required columns are properly completed.
6. Complete all the details in the Client Window Details on this view.
7. If all details are complete, feel free to click the Verify Transfer Button to check if all details are complete.
8. Make sure to click the Validate Button by the Text Label and a notification should show at the Top-Left of the screen.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'Set Location' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Steps to Begin:
1. Complete all available fields in this window form based on your client's documents.
2. Ensure the Customer and Source Location are set correctly — these are the two most important fields.
After setting the correct Source Location, a "Location Related Stocks" button will appear at the top-center of the screen. That's all you have to do right now. Remember to save the record in order for the next instruction to appear.
Tip: The shortcut key to save is Alt + S
Note: If the button does not appear, the Source Location was not set properly. You may skip other fields where information is not yet available.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'Select Stocks' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Steps to Pick Pallets:
1. Click "Location Related Stocks" button (top-center of screen).
2. Check the Pallet Lines you want to include
3. Click Checkout to proceed.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'To create return' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Note: If no return is needed, simply generate the Picklist and give it to the Checker. Wait for the picklist to return, then complete the window form details and Verify the transfer.
Steps to Create a Return:
1. Generate the Picklist.
2. Click the "Return Pallets" button.
3. Set the Return Reason to Partial Withdraw.
4. Process the return.
The system will automatically redirect you to the Receiving Report (RR), where you can generate the Tally Sheet for the Checker.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'Go back to wr' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
Next Steps:
1. Generate the Tally Sheet (if just arrived on this page).
2. Return to the WR by pressing Alt + B or clicking the WR reference (top-left of screen) it looks like "M/WR/000000" or just click the value inside "Return of" Field inside the window form.

div.invisible: next_step_status != 'Return RR Complete Pallet Details' or is_void_return or is_void_wr

xpath.div:
⚠️ Double-Check Required:
Verify the Tally Sheet carefully. Ensure the Pallet # and Location of all returned pallets are correctly updated if any changes were made.
Please make sure to Validate the WR first before validating the this RR return!

Steps to Begin:
1. Complete all available fields in this window form based on your client's documents.
2. Ensure the Destination Location is set correctly.
3. Make sure to save the your changes!
Tip: The shortcut key to save is "Alt + S"
Note: You may skip fields where information is not yet available.

div.invisible: not show_return_alert or state in ['done'] or not x_studio_record_lines_counter

xpath.div:
⚠️ Before Validating the Withdrawal Record:
Wait for the Picklist to return and make sure to double-check all details.
Update all Actual Values under Pallet Breakdown — especially if this transaction includes a return.
🔸 Tip: Required columns are highlighted in Gold (e.g., Pallet Weight (KG) = 1000 → Actual Weight Out = 500).
Enter the actual values (e.g., 500) in their respective Gold-highlighted column before proceeding. Once done, simply complete the window form view and Verify the transfer.
Note: For Additional Charges such as Repacking, Resacking, Unloaded by Vifel, etc., please go to the Note / Additional Charges Tab and look for the Additional Charges Field.
